# Client Intelligence Report Template

## Template Location

**Domain**: Client Intelligence
**Generated By**: Specialized agents (client-icp-analyst, client-branding-intelligence, etc.) or deliverable-integrator
**Last Updated**: 2025-12-02

---

## Standard Report Structure (CANONICAL - DO NOT MODIFY)

This is the **canonical structure** for all client intelligence executive reports. All future reports MUST follow this exact format to ensure consistency across projects.

### Design System

**Color Palette**:
- Primary Gradient: `linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%)` (purple/indigo)
- Background: Same gradient, fixed attachment
- Cards: White (#ffffff) with soft shadows
- Text: Gray scale (#1a202c to #718096)

**Typography**:
- Font Family: Inter (Google Fonts)
- Font Weights: 300, 400, 500, 600, 700, 800
- Hero Title: 4rem, weight 800
- Section Headers: 2.5rem, weight 700
- Body Text: 1rem, weight 400

**Layout**:
- Max Width: 1400px container
- Section Padding: 80px vertical, 40px horizontal
- Card Border Radius: 16-24px
- Box Shadows: Layered with rgba opacity

**CDN Dependencies**:
```html
<script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
<script src="https://d3js.org/d3.v7.min.js"></script>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
```

---

## Section-by-Section Structure

### 1. Scroll Progress Bar (Fixed)
**Location**: Top of viewport, fixed position
**Design**: 4px height, gradient background matching theme
**Behavior**: Updates width based on scroll position (JavaScript)

### 2. Sticky Navigation (Fixed Right)
**Location**: Top-right, fixed at `top: 80px, right: 40px`
**Design**:
- White background with backdrop-filter blur
- Rounded card (12px radius)
- Auto-highlight active section
- Hover effects with left border accent

**Navigation Items** (anchor links):
1. Cover
2. Executive Summary
3. ICP Profiles
4. SEO Strategy
5. Competitive Analysis
6. Strategic Priorities
7. Next Actions

### 3. Hero Section (Cover Page)
**Design**: Full-viewport height, gradient background
**Content Structure**:
```html
<section class="hero-gradient">
  <div class="text-center">
    <h1 class="hero-title">[CLIENT NAME]</h1>
    <p class="hero-subtitle">[One-line positioning statement]</p>
    <div class="report-badge">Client Intelligence Report</div>
    <p class="report-date">Generated: [Date]</p>
  </div>
</section>
```

**Required Elements**:
- Client name (4rem, weight 800)
- Positioning tagline (1.5rem, weight 300, opacity 0.9)
- Report type badge
- Generation date

### 4. Executive Summary Section
**Layout**: White card container, max-width 1400px
**Content Blocks**:

**A. Key Metrics Dashboard** (4-column grid):
```html
<div class="grid grid-cols-4 gap-6">
  <div class="metric-card">
    <div class="metric-value">[VALUE]</div>
    <div class="metric-label">[LABEL]</div>
  </div>
  <!-- Repeat 4x -->
</div>
```

**Metric Cards**:
1. Strategic Coherence Score (percentage with /100)
2. Total Keyword Opportunity (volume number)
3. ICP Segments (count)
4. Competitive Position (rating or status)

**B. Business Overview** (2-3 paragraphs):
- What the company does (core value proposition)
- Market position and differentiation
- Validation status (pilot/PMF/scaling)

**C. Critical Success Factors** (2x2 grid of cards):
```html
<div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-6">
  <div class="card">
    <h4>[Factor Title]</h4>
    <p>[1-2 sentence description]</p>
  </div>
  <!-- Repeat 4x -->
</div>
```

**Per-ICP Card Structure**:
```html

  <!-- Header -->

    <span class="icp-percentage">[X]% of Revenue</span>

  <!-- Motivations -->

  <!-- Unit Economics -->

      <span class="value">$[amount]</span>

    <div class="metric">
```

**ICP Card Requirements**:
- Each ICP gets full-width stacked card (not side-by-side)
- Avatar circle at top center (120px diameter, gradient background)

## JavaScript Requirements

### 1. Scroll Progress Bar
```javascript
window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
  const scrolled = (window.scrollY / (document.documentElement.scrollHeight - window.innerHeight)) * 100;
  document.getElementById('scroll-progress').style.width = scrolled + '%';
});
```

### 2. Sticky Navigation Active State
```javascript
const sections = document.querySelectorAll('section[id]');
const navItems = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item');

window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
  let current = '';
  sections.forEach(section => {
    const sectionTop = section.offsetTop;
    if (pageYOffset >= sectionTop - 200) {
      current = section.getAttribute('id');
    }
  });

  navItems.forEach(item => {
    item.classList.remove('active');
    if (item.getAttribute('href').slice(1) === current) {
      item.classList.add('active');
    }
  });
});
```

### 3. Smooth Scroll to Anchors
```javascript
document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(anchor => {
  anchor.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    document.querySelector(this.getAttribute('href')).scrollIntoView({
      behavior: 'smooth'
    });
  });
});
```

## Print Optimization

```css
@media print {
  /* Hide navigation and interactive elements */
  .sticky-nav,
  #scroll-progress,
  .no-print {
    display: none !important;
  }

  /* Optimize sections for print */
  section {
    min-height: auto;
    page-break-inside: avoid;
    padding: 40px 20px;
  }

  /* Ensure cards fit on pages */
  .card,
  .icp-card,
  .metric-card {
    page-break-inside: avoid;
    box-shadow: none;
    border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  }

  /* Adjust typography for print */
  body {
    background: white;
  }

  .hero-gradient {
    background: white;
    color: #1a202c;
    border-bottom: 4px solid #667eea;
  }
}
```

## Quality Checklist

Before delivering the report, verify:

- ✅ All 9 sections present and complete
- ✅ Purple/indigo gradient consistent throughout
- ✅ Inter font loads correctly from Google Fonts
- ✅ Sticky navigation highlights active section
- ✅ Scroll progress bar updates smoothly
- ✅ All ICP cards show complete data (demographics, pain points, economics)
- ✅ SEO tables sortable and properly formatted
- ✅ Competitor cards show threat levels accurately
- ✅ Timeline visualization clear and actionable
- ✅ Print CSS tested (command+P preview)
- ✅ Mobile responsive (test at 768px, 1024px, 1440px)
- ✅ No console errors in browser dev tools
- ✅ File size under 200 KB (excluding external CDN assets)
